note.en: A small turrid snail under about 1 cm long that lives on sand and rubble; it is a venomous hunter of worms but far too small to harm people. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Limón, undated). Depth was not recorded.
note.es: Un caracol túrrido pequeño, de menos de 1 cm, que vive en arena y escombro coralino; caza gusanos con veneno pero es demasiado pequeño para dañar a una persona. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Limón, sin fecha). No se anotó la profundidad.

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Limón, undated)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: One undated museum specimen from Limón.
